activity_summary: You stood through evening prayer. The almanac names Simon and Jude. The prayer stayed the prayer. You did not stay for a second turn, and you did not bring Saturday's sermon forward into it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood the prayer and did not lengthen it.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Read the evening prayer and was not asked for more.

facets.activity: Stood through evening prayer for Simon and Jude
